name: Heading Anchors
description: A small # link beside every section heading that appears on hover or focus. One click copies a link straight to that section and scrolls to it smoothly. Stable ids from the heading text.

panels.title: Heading anchors
panels.description: The link that appears beside section headings. Changes apply to a page the next time it is published.

fields.name: enabled
fields.title: Show heading links
fields.description: Turn this off to leave every page exactly as it was rendered.

choices.title: In the margin before the heading

fields.name: color
fields.title: Colour
fields.description: The link and the copied message. Leave empty for blue (#2563eb).

fields.name: copy
fields.title: Copy the link when clicked
fields.description: Clicking the symbol copies the full address of that section, ready to paste.

fields.name: copied-text
fields.title: Copied message
fields.description: Shown briefly after copying. Leave empty for "Link copied".

fields.name: exclude
fields.title: Pages to skip
fields.description: Slugs, separated by commas, that never get heading links. For example: home, contact
